column1: # Open pull requests in the linux-surface org by people (3 surfacebot update PRs left out). Snapshot 2026-11-13.
# Source: GitHub search is:pr is:open, each PR page read for review and maintainer comments, heads fetched with git and checked
#   against the patch series (tools/closed_pr_novel.py), linux-surface/kernel v7.3 and iptsd master (git merge-tree).
# maint_response: what qzed, StollD or danielzgtg said, if anything. Most open PRs have no maintainer reply.
# state: new | active | waiting (no reply) | stalled (no movement for months) | needs-update (reviewer asked for changes) |
#   competing | superseded-upstream | moved | on-list | draft | stale-repo

column9: note
Skip detection on frames below the deactivation threshold. Merges cleanly.
Adaptive neutral mode for contact detection (addresses erratic touch that the wiki calibration works around). Merges cleanly.
Debounce eraser and button flags to avoid spurious stylus lifts with MPP 2 pens (Slim Pen 2). Merges cleanly.
udev: keep the systemd tag across change events (iptsd@ unit losing its device). Merges cleanly.
udev: hide raw ithc input nodes duplicated by iptsd (iptsd#220: duplicate events, 16:9 distortion). Merges cleanly.
Remove StopWhenUnneeded=yes from iptsd@.service: the service stops itself about 6 s after a cold boot. Matches SP9 reports of touch missing after boot. One-line change, merges cleanly.
DisableOnStylusLevel: disable touch at proximity, contact or never. Author is an SP9 user who runs it (zeroxoneafour/linux-surface-config). Merges cleanly.

Backports the v7.4-rc1 camera work to 7.3: Sakari ipu_bridge_get_ipu6(), Rimoli's ov5693 clock-lane gate and per-IPU sensor configs, Lebedev's ov13858 flip controls. Makes the SP9 front camera stream on 7.3; moot once the series moves to 7.4. Supersedes #180 and the 0x4800 write in #181.
Fix OVTID858 link frequency count in the downstream ipu-bridge entry (count 4 with one frequency). Same goal as #174. Mainline v7.4 already has the correct entry, so only matters for 7.3 and older.
